verdict.rationale: Cal.com documents its own availability schedules: users can create schedules so event types are available at specific times, attach non-default schedules to event types, and manage schedules via the MCP server. That covers the working-hours core of the story. Date overrides and out-of-office periods never appear in the evidence, and one hands-on user reported availability seemed limited to 9am–5pm with no evening hours. That report is a usability caveat, not a concrete contradiction of schedule creation. Missing for 10: documented date overrides, out-of-office periods, detail on working-hours configuration (e.g. evening ranges), and independent corroboration.
